summary.text: John James is the U.S. Representative for Michigan's 10th District and the Republican nominee for governor, with running mate Jay DeBoyer. A West Point graduate and former Army Apache pilot, he led his family's logistics company before running for the U.S. Senate in 2018 and 2020 and winning his House seat in 2022. His platform calls for eliminating the state income tax, lower energy costs, school choice and a parents' bill of rights, and full funding for law enforcement.

paragraphs.text: Born in Southfield and raised in Detroit; graduated from West Point in 2004 and served eight years in the Army as an aviation officer, including Iraq combat tours.
Master's degree from Penn State and an MBA from the University of Michigan; became president of James Group International, a Detroit supply-chain company.
Republican nominee for U.S. Senate in 2018 and 2020 (lost to Debbie Stabenow and Gary Peters); elected to the U.S. House in 2022 and re-elected in 2024.
